canonicalization.request_body_projection: the closed REQUEST object with request_body_sha256 omitted
canonicalization.routing_canonical_projection: the closed registry-routing/1 object with canonical_sha256 and proof.signature omitted
canonicalization.routing_recipients_projection: the recipients array after routing_recipient_order sorting

capabilities.name: townsquare.delivery.receive
capabilities.meaning: make one active subscribed agent seat eligible for materialized delivery

capabilities.name: townsquare.delivery.claim
capabilities.meaning: claim only deliveries selected from the current server-bound subject

capabilities.name: townsquare.delivery.deposit
capabilities.meaning: record durable private-mailbox placement under a current claim fence

capabilities.name: townsquare.delivery.ack
capabilities.meaning: record explicit recipient or accepted agent-specific delegate acknowledgment

capabilities.name: townsquare.delivery.fail
capabilities.meaning: report one bounded sanitized transport failure under a current claim fence

capabilities.name: townsquare.delivery.redrive
capabilities.meaning: create one linked next-generation delivery without mutating original evidence

capabilities.name: townsquare.delivery.audit.read.recipient
capabilities.meaning: read the server-filtered audit projection for the bound recipient

capabilities.name: townsquare.delivery.restricted.read
capabilities.meaning: receive restricted pointer metadata when the selected courier profile and policy both permit it

non_disclosure.log_rule: use only request_id, external code, and sanitized policy reason; omit target, recipient, notice, delivery, count, and cursor metadata

identity_and_revocation.revocation_check: CURRENT binding and revocation are checked on every claim, deposit, acknowledgment, fail, redrive, and view
identity_and_revocation.revoked_during_lease: reject mutation under the lease, preserve history, and append the server-selected WITHHELD or CANCELLED disposition

snapshot_evidence.last_accepted_watermark_rule: reject a lower watermark; accept an equal watermark only when canonical_sha256 is identical; atomically persist a higher watermark with the materialization
snapshot_evidence.invalid_or_unavailable_behavior: park materialization and audit; never fall back to v2 opaque data

materialization.recipient_set: freeze on first successful materialization from one authenticated snapshot
materialization.recipient_uniqueness: agent_id and seat_id are each unique in a routing result; ambiguous or duplicate active ownership fails closed
materialization.delivery_id_derivation: d- plus lowercase SHA-256 hex of RFC8785 JCS over [delivery-id/1, notice_id, recipient_agent_id, generation]
materialization.host_target_rule: expand to each active eligible subscribed agent seat on that host; the host never becomes a recipient delivery
materialization.agent_target_rule: resolve exactly the addressed active eligible subscribed agent seat; never include sibling agents

idempotency.matching_request: return the original stored result without a second state transition
idempotency.comparison: compare request_body_sha256 computed from the canonical request_body_projection

leases.expiry: append LEASE_EXPIRED and make the same delivery reclaimable with a strictly greater lease_epoch
leases.stale_or_cross_claim: reject and audit without disclosing delivery existence

retry.policy: capped backoff with an implementation-declared finite cap; the exact duration is not frozen by Story 189
retry.client_authority: failure reporter cannot select retry, park, cancel, withhold, or next_available_at
retry.server_authority: Ledger alone selects RETRY or PARK and appends the corresponding event
retry.poison_non_starvation: claim selection excludes PARKED and not-yet-available deliveries
retry.offline_rule: offline time does not consume a failure attempt; the delivery remains pending or retryable

receipts.meaning: temporary transport lease; not a delivery receipt
transport attempt; not a delivery receipt
pointer durably persisted to the recipient private mailbox; not recipient acknowledgment
explicit idempotent receipt by the recipient agent or accepted agent-specific delegate; not understanding, acceptance, action, or completion

redrive.result: create exactly one new delivery with generation original_generation plus one and link both delivery IDs
redrive.idempotency: same canonical request returns the original new-generation result

RECIPIENT.scope: only the server-bound recipient delivery and sanitized events

AUDITOR.scope: source, routing, recipient, actor, fence, digest, correlation, and time evidence

HOST_COURIER.admission: dedicated courier identity plus proven enforceable private per-seat mailbox ACL isolation
HOST_COURIER.claim_scope: only server-bound authorized_seat_ids on server-bound host_id
HOST_COURIER.restricted_visibility: only pointer metadata required for deposit and only with townsquare.delivery.restricted.read

DIRECT_AGENT.admission: server-bound agent identity for one recipient seat
DIRECT_AGENT.required_when: host mailbox isolation is unproven or restricted policy forbids courier visibility

courier_profiles.pinning: profile is pinned in routing and delivery evidence and revalidated at live canary admission

authority_boundaries.registry: routing eligibility and authenticated snapshot evidence
authority_boundaries.ledger: notice intent, frozen recipients, delivery state, attempts, receipts, retry, parking, and audit history
authority_boundaries.courier: pointer transport and bounded sanitized failure reporting only
authority_boundaries.vertical: work hierarchy, lifecycle, and acceptance; notification events cannot create or close work
authority_boundaries.revere: optional post-MVP wake acceleration only; no durable state or receipt authority
